article.title: Pronominaladverbio worunter
article.part: Discurso referido y pronominaladverbios — Indirekte Rede und Pronominaladverbien
article.chapter: Pronominaladverbien: da(r)- y wo(r)- — Pronominaladverbien: da(r)- und wo(r)-

claims.summary: Introduces the term 'Worunter' as a pronominal adverb formed by 'wor-' + 'unter', representing a question or relation about a non-personal thing, category, condition, or situation.
Explains how 'Worunter' is used in various expressions like 'unter etwas leiden', 'etwas unter etwas verstehen', and 'etwas unter etwas einordnen', and can also have a spatial reading.
Provides several examples of 'Worunter' in use, such as 'Worunter leidet sie?', 'Worunter verstehst du diesen Begriff?', 'Worunter fällt diese Ausgabe?', and 'Unter wem hat sie gearbeitet?'
Clarifies that 'Worunter' can correspond to 'de qué', 'bajo qué', 'en qué categoría', etc., and provides the rule for its formation when 'unter' starts with a vowel.
